tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /bka' 'dus sman sgrub gtor zlog bcas kyi zin tho bzhugs/ /na mo gu ru shrī badz+ra kro dhā ye/gter chen o rgyan gling pa'i gter byon ku
༄༅/ /bka' 'dus sman sgrub gtor zlog bcas kyi zin tho bzhugs/ /na mo gu ru shrī badz+ra kro dhā ye/gter chen o rgyan gling pa'i gter byon ku

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bka' 'dus sman sgrub gtor zlog bcas kyi zin tho bzhugs//na mo gu ru shrī badz+ra kro dhā ye/ gter chen o rgyan gling pa'i gter byon kun gzigs mkhyen brtse'i yang gter du byon pa'i bka' 'dus sman sgrub/ gtor bzlog dang bcas pa dkyus gcig tu nyin dgur bstar ba'i lag len/ 'don 'brigs zin thor bkod pa la/ rtsa gsum zhi khro'i sgrub pa spyi'i khog phub khyer bder bkod pa gcig shes kun grol gzhir bzhag la/ sna sel rnams sngon tu btang nas/ nyin dang po'i tho rang snga bar rdo rje 'tshams pas phur pa'i bdag bskyed sngon 'gros/ sngon du ma song na shog ling rnams la ling khrus tshad ldan/ tshogs bsgral skabs 'gugs bstim gnad ldan dang*/ dam sri'i mnan ling la mnan chas rgyal tho'i ser phreng ma phebs gong grub par bya/ drag po'i sbyin sreg bya

/ skor chog pa rnams nas khrus chog zla ba'i bdud rtsi ltar khrus bum bsgrub/ gzhung tshogs rnams kyis/ tshig bdun/ sku gsum gsol 'debs/ brgyud 'debs bsdus pa'i rjes rgyun khyer skyabs sems tshogs bsags mthar/ hūm̐: de bzhin nyid dbyings sogs kyi bdag bskyed/ bzlas pa/ bsdu ldang grub rjes zur 'debs rin chen phra tshom ltar bsang chu bsgrub/ sgrub khog ltar sa chog gi mchod brlab nas/ gshegs gsol mthar/ mchod rol ring ba'i 'og gtor ma 'bul zhing*/ mchod pa dang maṇ+ḍal bsdu/ slob dpon zhwa chos bcas gzhi der phebs shing dbang mchog phur pas sa dbang du bya ba nas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bzlas pa'i rjes dbang mchog phur pa bsdu/ bka' bsgo'i mjug mchod rol ring ba'i 'og /slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi gzhir dbang ldan nas brtsams/ lan gsum bskor zhing yungs thun brab cing rdo rjegasor/ las phur byang shar du gdab/ ser phreng gis shar nas brtsam rgyal tho btsug /dam sri mnan pa'i gcig ni brjod med sogs brjod skabs slob dpon gyis rdo rje rgya gram tshig re dang bstun rgya gram bcu bya/ las byang gi bro brdung gyer skabs/ drag po'i bro ra rtse mo lhor bstan/ mthe'u chung sbrel/ gshin rje'i sku'i rgyab kyi 'dod gsol/ gsang chen lhun grub sogs dang*/ 'khyil ba'i sku'i rgyab kyi 'dod gsol/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sogs bri/ brub khung du dam sri'i mnan ling bzhin bris pa'i ling ga bcug /nang du phebs shing*/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi nub nas shar du phyogs par sngags chas bcas stong thun bshad/ ma traṃ bsgral/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje 'gros kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi der/ hūm̐ gsum la bskor ba gcig /ha gsum la bskor ba gcig /phaṭa gsum la bskor ba gcig ste bskor ba gsum bskor nas/ dbus nas shar du zhal phyogs pas/ steng nas phyogs bzhir g.yas bskor/

shar lho nas 'og bar g.yon bskor gyis khro bcu'i phur pa gdab don gyi srung 'khor phrin las ltar/ hūm̐: ye shes rang rtsal 'bar ba'i sogs nas/ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bar ro/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi shar nas nub tu phyogs pas bzhengs te byang shar nas brtsam g.yas bskor gyis 'thor g.yab kyis bdud rtsi 'thor/ las rdor gyis g.yon bskor du khye ma med pa'am/ bar mtshams med pa legs par byug /lha sta gon tshom bu bkod grub rjes/ de mthar phyi mchod bskor bsham/ de mdun nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta phreng tshar du bsham/ phrin las ltar mchod rlabs rjes/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta sogs kyis dam tshig pa bskyed/ mchod pa rang gzhung gis 'thus/ spos dril bcas gsol ba gdab/ bum par zhi khro'i spyi dril brjod pas rdzas blug /mchod bstod/ zur 'debs kyi rjes chog skabs kyi mchod bstod sbyar/ bzlas pa zhi khro'i spyi dril bzla/ las bum zur 'debs kyi bsang chu ltar bsgrub/ dngos sta nyin gcig la sbrel skabs bdag gi rnal 'byor gong du song bas 'thus pas 'dir mi dgos/ khrus chog zla ba'i bdud rtsi ltar zhi drag phyed ma'i sbyong ba/ bden stobs skabs/ deng 'dir gsang ba zab mo'i cho gas dngos grub bsgrub pa la bar du zhes bsgyur zhing rten khrus gos zung 'bul zhing bkra shis kyi mnga' dbul ba'i bar bya/ rgyan bkod skabs slob dpon gyis spos sna/ yum gyis dar lam gyis sna drangs pa'i sman gyi pho brang*/ rgyal tshab rgyal thebs sogs kyis bum pa/ sku gsung thugs rten/ sman rag gtor gsum/ sgab bskor chas/ khro bcu'i phur pa/ ma traṃ rnams thogs nas/ zhi khro'i spyi dril dzab¿ dbyangs lan gsum dang sbrag dkyil 'khor bskor ba lan gsum rjes/ sman sgrub ltar/ gdod nas rnam dag gis lding khri 'og mar sman gyi pho brang bzhugs pa'i shar lho nas brtsams chang chu 'o ma rin chen rnams mtshams bzhi dang*/

sman gyi pho brang thog mañdza'i steng sman sgrub phab gta' chu gtsang gis brlan pa bzhugs/ zur gang bder chang phab zhib mor btul ba/ dam rtsi/ kha dog bsgyur byed/ rtsi rnams tshang bar bzhag /sman gyi pho brang steng gzung thag bzhag pa'i rdo rje dang*/ steng gi tshangs pa'i dmu thag sbrel/ sgrub khog gi rgyan bkod rnams gyer zhing*/ lding khri bar par/ dbus su rnam bum dung chos gzungs rdor dang bcas pa/ dbus dang phyogs mtshams rnams su sku tsaka rnams ma 'chol bar bkod/ dbang dang 'brel tshe dbang rdzas rnams kyang bkod/ lding khri gong mar/ sku rten thod sku spyi dpal chen po phyag rgya rgyas pa ltar bris pa/ gsung rten bka' 'dus glegs bam/ sngags byang gi tsakli/ thugs rten phyag mtshan tsakli dang shel rdo/ rgyab ngos sman gtor rak+ta/ de mthar nyer spyod bskor bshams bcas dang*/ sgab skor stod smad/ thugs yol sngon po/ gsung yol dmar po/ sku yol dkar po rnams nang nas phyir dkris / ru dar/ ral gri sogs dang*/ khro bcu'i phur pa dang ma traṃ bcas snga ma bzhin so sor ma 'chol bar bkod/ ma traṃ gyi khog pa ras bris 'og tu bzhag /dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du mchod gtor/ rgyab tu bskang gtor gzhung mthun/ lhor 'dod yon lnga/ byang du srung ma'i gtor ma dang chad brtan/ mdun du zhi drag gi nyer spyod mjug sprod/ sman gtor rak+ta/ mtha' bskor phyi nang tshogs mchod bcas brgya rtsas bskor zhing*/ bla med mchog gi mthar tshogs grol/ mchod pa sogs zhib par bshams nas/ yar 'tshogs gzhung zur tshogs pa thams cad dang*/ sgrub chen gyi las byed ma lus pa 'tshogs dgos/ rdo rje rgyal thebs zhwa chos bcas gral gsham nas/ stong thun bshad de/ mnga' gsol rjes zlos/ las rdor gyis thod pa'i bdud rtsi rim bzhin rdo rje rgyal po/ rgyal tshab dang rgyal thebs bzhi/ yum las rdor/ ging*/ 'tshams pa/ spyan pa/ dus mtshams pa ni dge bskos

bya rog kyang zer/ phyag tshang ni phyag gnyer/ byan po ni ma chen sogs la drangs shing mthar mchod rol ring ba bya/ yang rgyal thebs kyis gtong thun bshad de rtags gdab bya skabs/ mgrin par zhag gi zo ris zla phyed/ mkhur tshos la rak+ta'i thig le sum sgrom/ dpral bar thal chen tshom bu rtse gsum ris/ mthar mchod rol ring ba'i 'og 'dus pa spyi la rtags gdab grub par bya/ slob dpon chos gos dang zhwa 'phrag 'gel gyis dkyil 'khor mdun du bzhengs la brda sgo dbye skabs/ dbye sngags lan bzhi la dkyil 'khor la bskor zhing*/ phyogs bzhir lag gnyis khu tshur dpung mgor bsnol ba dbye ba'i phyag rgya re bya/ slar slob dpon dkyil 'khor mdun du bzhengs te thal sbyar gyis brda' phyag /a ti pu hoḥlan bzhir g.yas bskor gyis thal sbyar re dang*/ pra tits+tsha hoḥ'i skabs 'greng zhing 'dud rgya bcas/ lha rnams kyi phyag len gnang bar mos/ mched gsar logs su phyes/ rnying pa rnams nas bdud rtsi byin rlabs/ bsdu na/ yi ge gsum gyis bsang sbyang*/ dgu pa'i dzab¿ dbyangs lan gsum gyis brlab/ mchod pa'i zur 'debs bzhin brgyud mchod khā hi bcas bya/ dngos grub blang ba mi dgos/ bsdu na bka' bsgo bzhag /khro bo'i spyi dril/ hūm̐ bzhi/ drag 'beb/ rkang rag /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ gsum gyis srung 'khor bsgom/ rgyal tshab bam/ rdo rje rgyal thebs kyis bdud rtsi 'grim/ chu 'dis 'grub/ mthar/ 'og gi zhes myong ba sogs/ gyur par bsam la rdo rje'i g.yar dam bzung ba 'di'i rjes zlos/ i dan+te sogs/ slob dpon la bdud rtsi drangs mi dgos/ gzhan gsar rnying thams cad la g.yon bskor gyis drangs/ mthar dam tshig gtong thun rgyal tshab bam/ rdo rje rgyal thebs kyis bshad/ brgya brdung rol 'og /las rdor gyis spos dang g.yab dar sna lnga/ slob dpon gyis g.yab dril/ yum gyis rdor dril phreng ba/ rgyal tshab g.yab dar sna lnga dang*/

rgyal thebs bzhi'i g.yab dril bcas dkyil 'khor bskor zhing*/ zhwa chos bcas dkyil 'khor mdun du phreng tshar gyis dkyil 'khor la phyogs par bzhengs/ 'dus pa thams cad zhwa bcas rang gral nas bzhengs te/ lha skos su gdabs/ sngags zhi khro'i spyi dril/ mthar 'bebs sum brdung gis byin 'bebs/ dus gsum bde gshegs/ mthar 'bebs sum brdung gis sman sgrub ltar kun bzang rdor sems sogs kyi mthar/ brgyud gsum rol mo la dkyil 'khor lan gsum bskor zhing*/ phyogs bzhi so sor g.yab dar lan re bya/ 'di nub sgrub pa'i thun gyi dbu mi 'dzug na/ sgrub khog tu gsal ba bzhin dang*/ thun gyi dbu 'dzug te nyin dang po'i go chod byed skabs/ bsdu na phrin las nar ma'i skyabs sems tshogs bsags lan gsum rjes/ mchod rlabs nas/ byin 'bebs dang spyan 'dren skabs/ las rdor gyis zhwa bcas spos dang g.yab dar gyis dkyil 'khor la lan re bskor ba mthong rgyud bzhin bya zhing*/ mchod phreng zur 'debs ma sbyar ba'i mchod pa gzhung bzhin bstod pa'i mtha' bar btang*/ zur 'debs rin chen phra tshom ltar dzab¿ khang phye ba nas/ khro bo'i spyi dril bzlas pa grub pa dang*/ zhi khro'i spyi dril sbrel ma gdangs bcas lan bdun gyer skabs/ thun dpon gyis me tog phul zhing pad bskor bcas rgyal tshab bam/ rdo rje rgyal thebs la thun thag zhu/ 'di nas bzung dzab¿ rgyun ma chad pa dang*/ thun thag stong par ma bor ba dgos/ 'di mtshams dzab¿ mchod/ rak+ta'i mchod bstod/ yig brgya'i rjes/ bka' srungs bskang bshags/ tshogs skong*/ lhag ma'i skabs/ lhag ma btson 'dzin dkyil 'khor gyi lho nub tu bya zhing*/ bskul chad brtan bkra shis mtha' bar zur 'debs bzhin btang*/ grub na nyu le bskrad pa/ byin 'bebs dzab¿ dbyangs bcas tshogs gzhung nas bya ba'am/ mi lcogs na rdo rje 'tshams pas bya/ rta bro'i skabs rdo rje mtshams pas bgegs bskrad/

mtshan thun gsum 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bya/ ༈ /nyin gnyis par/ tshig bdun/ sku gsum gsol 'debs/ brgyud 'debs 'bring po'i mthar brgya brdung*/ bdag bskyed gsal zhing bsang chu bsgrub pa nas zur 'debs bzhin mthar chags su btang*/ bka' bsgo'i skabs rdo rje 'tshams pas thun brab pa kun la 'gres su shes dgos/ dzab¿ so so'i skabs dzab mchod rgyas pa'i lugs bzhin tu sbyar la/ khro bo spyi dril gyi stong tshigs rjes/ bum bzlas sgrub khog gi bum pa sta gon skabs su 'byung ba nyid kyis gtso bum dang las kyi bum pa gnyis sgrub/ de mtshams tshe sgrub mthar/ yig brgya lan gsum gyis sngags kyi nus pa brtan pa'i bar zu ra 'debs bzhin btang bas nyin thun dang po 'grub/ rdo rje 'tshams pa'am rgyal thebs res mos kyis/ nyu le bskrad cing byin 'bebs/ dzab¿ dbyangs bcas bya/ slar phrin las nar ma'i mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsam/ mchod phreng zur 'debs mi sbyar ba tsam las bzlas pa la thug gi bar sngar bzhin btang*/ 'grub na zhi ba dang*/ dpal nyer gcig /khro bo'i spyi dril bcas bzla ba dang*/ stong tshig 'bring po'i lugs ltar dgos shing*/ mi nus na zhi khro'i spyi dril so sor ci nus re bsnyen/ bum pa dang tshe sgrub dor ba'i dzab¿ mchod/ rak+ta'i mchod bstod/ yig brgya bcas dang*/ gong ltar nyu le bskrad pa sogs kyis nyin thun gnyis pa grub/ slar phrin las nar ma'i mchod pa byin brlab nas/ yig brgya'i mtha' bar thun gnyis pa bzhin bskyar rjes/ bka' srung gtor chog nas bzung bkra shis kyi bar zur 'debs bzhin nar 'ded kyis btang mthar/ tshogs gzhung nas sgrub khog ltar nyul le bskrad cing*/ thams cad bzhengs la zhwa bcas byin 'bebs dzab¿ dbyangs bcas grub nas tshogs grol/ mtshan thun 'don lugs/ thun so so'i dbur/ phrin las nar ma'i skyabs sems tshogs bsags rjes srung 'khor/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas yig brgya'i mtha' bar nyin thun gsum pa bzhin dang*/

de nas nyul le bskrad cing*/ byin 'bebs dzab¿ dbyangs bcas so sor bya zhing*/ thor thun mthar yig brgya'i rjes/ zur skong mi sbyar ba'i tshogs rkyang pa lhag ma'i mtha' bar btang*/ rjes chog mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ brtan bzhugs rnams zur 'debs ltar dang*/ bsdu ldang bsngo ba bkra shis bcas rgyun khyer mjug gi mdor bsdus btang rjes/ nyul le bskrad cing byin 'bebs dzab¿ dbyangs bcas bya dgos/ de lta bu'i sgrub pa nyin gsum sogs btang ba'i nyin tha mar/ nyin thun dang po rak+ta'i mchod bstod yig brgya'i rjes/ rgyun gyi dngos grub blang ba zur 'debs ltar gyer zhing*/ 'dus pa rnams la bdud rtsi drangs/ de mtshams nyul le bskrad pa sogs rgyun ltar bya/ thun gnyis par/ sman khrol sgrub/ hūm̐: bdag nyid rtsa ba'i sogs mthar chags su btang*/ thun sngags brje skabs/ da lam bzlog sgrub dang sbrel dgos gshis/ zhi khro'i spyi dril dang*/ khrol sgrub sogs 'og ma 'bru bcu gsum pa sbyar ba'i thun gdangs kyi skabs/ thun brje zhing*/ sngags gsum sbrel dbu btsugs pa sogs mthong rgyun ltar dgos pa khyad par tsam las/ sman sgrub gzhung gsal bzhin nyin thun phyi ma rnams mthar dbyung*/ mtshan thun snga ma bzhin/ bzlas pa'i rjes stong tshig mthar sman sgrub sbrel zhing*/ bzlas pa'i 'bru gsum pa'i skabs/ sngag gsum sbrel gyi thun bzung zhing*/ sman sgrub thun snga ma rnams ltar la/ thor thun rjes tshogs mchod sbyar ba sogs snga ma bzhin dgos shing*/ byin 'bebs rjes sman gyi byin 'bebs re sbyar ba khyad par ro/ de lta bu'i khrol sgrub nyin grangs bcad cing*/ sang btags btsag gi do nub sman spol chas chang gtsang ma bshams la/ bgegs bskrad cing byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa dang*/ khyad par phyir nang las byang gi bdud rtsi byin rlabs skabs dmigs pas khyab par bya dgos/ thems pa'i nyin dang po sman gyi byin 'bebs mtha' bar sngar nyin mo ltar btang rjes/

sman btags pa btsags kyi thog mar/ sman sgrub gzhung gsal sman mchod sngon song sman gyi dngos grub blang ba grub kyi bar btang*/ bar 'dir rdo rje rgyal thebs kyis gtong thun sngon song dbyangs bor len bcas rtags gdabs nges par bya dgos/ gzhan gzhung gsal bzhin pho brang dkyil 'khor du bzhugs zin pa'i nar 'ad ེ da kyis btang la/ phyag len rnams mthong rgyun bzhin zhib tshag ldan pa gal che/ long khyab med pa sogs kyis phyi sgrub nyin grangs mang po mi lcogs na/ 'di nub kyi thun la phyi sgrub kyi dbu 'dzug dgos pas/ hūm̐: snying po rang byung sogs kyi dam tshig gsal gdab nas/ 'od zhu'i bar btang la/ bdud rtsi dgug pa'i dzab¿ thun gdangs skabs/ zhi khro'i spyi dril dang sbrel dgos pa ni 'di phyin thams cad la mtshungs par sbyor dgos pa khyad par ba dang*/ gong 'phros slar yang thun lan gcig bskyar grub na legs shing*/ nus min skabs dang bstun/ gang ltar yang bka' srung phyin sngar ltar mthar dbyung*/ mtshan thun gsum po'ang snga ma ltar la khrol sgrub dor la phyi sgrub la 'jug pa sogs kyi khyad par zhib mo mthong rgyun ltar gnang dgos/ de lta bu'i sgrub zhag gis bdud rtsi gnad dbab/ bdud rtsi bskyil ba/ 'bebs pa so sor thun drug re 'gro dgos kyang*/ long khyab kyis ma lcogs na/ phyi sgrub nyin gnyis pa'i nyin mtshan thun drug so sor gsham gsal le tshan rnams rim par sbyar dgos kyang*/ da lam 'jug bde'i slad nyin thun dang po'i mjug gnad dbab 'od zhu bcas dang*/ thun gnyis par gnad dbab bzlas pa'i rjes/ bdud rtsi bskyil ba 'od zhu bcas btang*/ da lam dgos sgrub dgos stabs/ dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams 'dir bshams mi dgos/ sman gyi pho brang bzhugs yul stegs kyi khar thod chang khebs ldan bkod pas 'thus/ thun gsum par bskyil sngags rjes/ dbab pa gsang sgo dbye zhing bdud rtsi dbab pa'i bzlas pa stong tshig bcas sbyar ro/

'od zhu mi byed par sngon tshe khrag 'thung sogs bzlas pa'i mthar stong tshig /'od zhu'i rjes srung ma'i gtor chog sogs sngar ltar bya/ mtshan thun gsum la/ 'ju 'dul lam phyi sgrub skabs ltar las gnad dbab phyin ma sbyar na'ang chog rgyu bgyid pa las 'os med snyam mo/ phyir nang snga bar tshogs nas/ phrin las bzlas pa'i rjes sman sgrub nyin snga ma'i thun gsum pa'i skabs ltar btang ba'i bzlas pa mañdzu shrī can mthar stong tshig 'bul/ 'od zhu mi byed/ bsnyen rgyun pas spyi dril gnyis/ dngos grub spyir gsol

ba'i rang byung bdud rtsi'i pho brang mjug gi sngags/ mchan/ dzab¿ btags pa bzla dgos/ rgyun du skabs 'dir sgrub khog dngos grub len chog gi dbur 'jug pa yin kyang*/ da lam sgrub bzlog dang sbrel ba'i sman gyi dngos grub len pa rkyang pa bya dgos pas sman sgrub nang gsal bgegs bskrad nas/ don bshags rjes/ hūm̐ bh+yo: chos sku spros bral sogs/ puṇ+ye tiṣ+ṭhā oṃ gyis mnga' gsol ba'i bar mthar chags su btang*/ de nas sngags rgyun pa rnams kyis dngos grub gsol/ sngags bzhag ste/ zhi khro spyi dril rkyang pas thun bzung*/ rin chen rgyal thebs dpon g.yog gis rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bya/ yar 'tshogs/ dmar chen gtor ma'i las rim ltar khro bo'i spyi dril lan gcig brjod pa sogs bzlog dkyil gsal 'debs nas/ mchod par zur 'debs ma sbyar ba'i bstod pa'i mthar bzlas dmigs gsal btab nas/ zhi ba dang khro bo'i spyi dril drag po'i sham bcas sbrel thun gdangs kyis dzab¿ rgyun bzung*/ gzhung tshogs pa rnams nas khro bo'i spyi dril sham can gyi bzlas pa brgya yan gang 'grub/ srung ma'i gtor chog nas/ bzlog pa grub kyi bar dang*/ rgyun gyi rjes rim ltar nar 'ded btang nas/ bkra shis grub rjes nyul le bskrad cing*/ rgyun gyi byin 'bebs rkyang pa dang*/ zhi khro spyi dril sham can gyi dzab¿ dbyangs bya/ phyir nyin/ nyin dang po gnyis pa sgrub pa'i skabs ltar/ gsum par gong du brjod pa ltar gyis grub/ 'phang ba'i thun dang po sngar ltar dang*/ thun gnyis par zlog dkyil gsal gdab nas/ bzlog pa'i mtha' bar btang*/ de mtshams srin mo za lam gyi yo byad rnams dang*/ sgo drung du mnan dong grab shoms dang*/ ser phreng chas sta gon tshar ba dang*/ zor sgo dbye ba nas/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod/ mthar slob dpon gyis khro bo'i spyi dril sham bu can bzla zhing gtor ma rnams phyir dpag

/phyi rol bla g.yel lta bu'i zor tshug steng sleb pa dang*/ gtor chen stegs la bkod de/ srin mo za lam/ bh+yoḥ bzlog byed ma gcig sogs kyis btang ba nas/ phur bsgyur mthar sngar bzhin drag sngags bzla zhing byon la/ 'phang ba'i sar sleb pa dang*/ gdab kha'i dbur 'byung ba'i byin rlabs sngon 'gros/ gser skyems bzu+u dpang dang*/ dmigs bya bskyed pa/ 'gugs gzhug lan gsum bcas btang rjes/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ nga ni dpal chen sogs nas rta bro grub kyi bar btang mthar/ nang du slebs pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor mdun lcogs stegs ras dkar bkab pa'i khar/ sgrub khog ltar dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams bsham dgos/ slar tshe sgrub bzlas pa/ tshe 'gugs mtha' bar lan gcig bskyar ba rten 'brel gyi gnad du bshad/ de nas sgrub khog nang gsal dngos grub dbang du byed pa'i bzlas pa sbyor dgos pas/ slar rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po sogs dmigs pa gsal btab nas/ zhi khro spyi dril sham bur kā ya wā kā sogs btags pa thog mar thun gdangs bcas/ bsnyen rgyun pa rnams kyis dngos grub len sngags rgyun/ 'di nyin dngos grub len chog ma grub bar nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha rnams la rjes chog bzhin mchod bstod phul te rten dang dbyer med du bzhugs par dmigs/ lhag chad kha skong nas bkra shis bar grub pa dang*/ sngar bzhin nyul le bskrad cing byin 'baibs dzab¿ dbyangs bcas bya/ mtshan thun gsum sngar bzhin la gzhung bsnyen grub pa dang*/ gong gsal gyi dmigs pa sbyar nas dngos grub len sngags nyid la thun bzung ngo*/ /phyir nang cung snga bar 'tshogs nas/ gzhung 'don nyin dang po cha tshang tshe sgrub stong tshig mthar snga nub bzhin dngos grub dbang du byed pa'i dmigs pa sbyar ba brgya rtsa sogs bzlas la/ stong tshig btang*/ rak+ta'i mchodapa/ yig brgya'i mtha' bar btang*/ de mtshams bka' srung gtor chog /tshogs kyi dngos grub blang ba'i mtha' bar btang*/

tshogs bsgral skabs nyul le'i ling ga mer bsreg pa'i thal ba chos skyong gi gtor mar bstab/ skabs 'dir zur 'tshogs rnams kyang cho ga bsdus grub pa dgos/ de nas gzhung zur mnyam du 'tshogs/ phrin las ltar bka' bsgo bgegs bskrad/ rdo rje mtshams pas bsgrub rdzas dang*/ mched lcam rnams la thun brab/ srung 'khor sgom grub pa dang*/ las rdor dang*/ rgyal tshab bam/ slob dpon gyis g.yab dril bcas dkyil 'khor mdun du 'greng la/ byin 'bebs dus gsum bde gshegs gyer mthar sgrub rdzas dang mched lcam rnams la byin dbab/ ye shes sku mchog dang yig brgya cung zad bzlas pas nyes byas bshags/ dngos grub bskul ba/ gter gzhung zab khrid ltar/ hūm̐ḥ nam mkha'i sku mnga' sogs bzhi dril gyis/ bla med 'bras bu'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ bar mchod rol/ sgrub khog gi hūm̐ḥ lha dang rig 'dzin sogs tshig bzhi mtshams dang sngags la dril bsil/ mthar mchod rol/ de ltar rtse gcig sogs kyis dmigs pa gsal la/ zhi khro'i spyi dril sham du kā ya sogs stong phrag bzlas/ dngos grub rang la bsdus rjes mchod rol 'og /rgyal thabs gtso bo zhwa chos bcas phebs te sgrub rdzas rnams slob dpon la 'bul zhing*/ hrīḥ ye shes lus can mthar mchod rol/ gter gzhung khrid yig gi dngos grub blang ba snga ma'i 'phros/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: dpal chen zhi khro sogs shwa lo ka dang*/ zhi khro'i spyi dril mthar/ kā ya sid+dhi sogs bzla bzhin mchod rol ring po'i 'og /rdo rje rgyal pos rnam bum/ rgyal thebs rnams kyis thod sku/ sku tsaka sogs sku gsung thugs rten rnams kyi dbang mched lcam rnams la bskur/ las rdor rnams kyis dngos grub byin rlabs kyi bza' bca' g.yas bskor dang*/ bdud rtsi g.yon bskor gyis drangs shing longs spyad/ slob dpon rnams rang gral du bzhugs grub nas mchod rol bzhag /dmigs pa brjod cing dgongs pa'i gdengs bskyed/

rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs brtan dang bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam gdabs/ slar yang skabs 'dir rgyas pa'i sbyin bsreg bskyar/ dbang dgos min skabs dang bstun/ tshogs la rol/ lhag ging bcas lhag ma btson 'dzin thams cad kyang 'bul/ sgrub khang gi thal ba rnams phyir bskyel ba phyag bzhes/ phrin las kyi bskul ba/ bka' srung gi gnyer gtad brjod cing gtor ma 'bul ba sogs/ gtang rag gi mchod bstod skabs phrin las nar ma bzhin mchod brlab dang*/ zur gsal mchod phreng gis mchod/ gzhung gi bstod pa tshang bas bstod cing*/ mchod rol/ dril bsil/ phrin las kyi bsdu ldang rjes/ sgrub khog gi ngar 'dzin rnam dag sogs dor la/ mi 'gyur mi shigs sogs go bsgos rgyas gdab/ 'dus spyi zhwa chos sogs ser phreng gis phyir phebs nas/ rgyal tho rnams bsdu/ phur pa bsdu ba'i phyir slob dpon nam rgyal tshab zhwa chos bcas dkyil 'khor nub tu 'khod/ gzhan rnams rang gral du bzhugs/ phyag gnyis skam pa'i rgyas phur pa ldog phyogs nas bton la/ phur rtse 'o ma dang dri chu'i nang du bcug ste/ bkrus pa'i thig pa phur shul du blugs pas/ bgegs kyi gtso bo rnams rmas pa sos te brgyal sangs nas dga' ba'i mdangs phyungs shing rang gnas su song bar bsam/ ras bris bsdus nas rang gral du bzhugs/ rdo rje rgyal po ma gtogs pas/ mched rgan gral rnams la gzhon gral pa rnams bzhengs nas phyag gsum bcas pus btsug thal sbyar gyis me tog bzung ste nongs bshags tshar gcig brjod/ yang rgan gral rnams kyis gzhon gral la sngar bzhin nongs bshags tshar gcig bya/ mched thams cad bzhengs nas slob dpon la phyag gsum byas te lus longs spyod 'bul ba'i mtshon byed las rdor gyis phreng ba rnams bsdus la/ slob dpon mdun lcogs stegs su bkod cing thams cad kyis thal sbyar te me tog dang bcas pas pus btsug gis/ hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon sogs brjod cing zhabs spyi bor blangs pa'i dod thams cad kyis slar phyag gsum nas rang gral du 'khod/

las rdor gyis phreng ba rnams slar so sor phyir 'bul bya/ smon lam ni/ kye hoḥ mi gnas ye shes sogs dang*/ hoḥ phyogs dus rtsa brgyud sogs/ dri med kun dga'i zab gter las byon pa dang*/ gzhan yang smon lam ji ltar rig pa'i mthar/ rgyal thebs gtso bos zhwa chos bcas gzhung gral gsham nas gtong thun sngon 'gros dbyangs bor len gyis mar me'i smon lam skabs mched rnams dar thag gis sbrel/ mar me thogs/ mthar mchod rol bya/ bzang spyod smon lam/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi sogs dang*/ gzhung gi bsngo ba/ dge ba 'di yis sogs rgyun khyer mjug ltar dang*/ zhwa bcas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis ni/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs spyi'i mthar mchod rol/ slar bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs kyi bkra shis rgyas par brjod cing*/ yi dam la rgyun khyer mjug gi /bde gshegs zhi ba sogs bka' 'dus bkra shis nges par sbyang bas/ bkra shis gral bskor sogs mtha' rgyas su byas pas legs par grub bo/ ༈ /lar nyin dgu ma'i skabs/ nyin dang por sa chog /sta gon/ dngos gzhi'i sgrub par 'jug cing*/ khro bo'i spyi dril bzlas rjes/ zhi khro'i spyi dril sbrel ma'i thun bzung*/ nyin gnyis par sgrub pa/ nyin gsum pa'i thun dang po'i bzlas pa'i rjes rgyun gyi dngos grub blangs/ snga dror rdo rje rgyal thebs sogs kyis zhi ba'i sbyin sreg blug cing*/ phyi sgrub drod 'bebs kyi mar me sbar/ sman khrol sgrub thun gnyis/ bsnyen rgyun la zhi khro'i spyi dril gnyis dang*/ khrol sgrub sngags gsum sbrel ba'i thun bzung*/ nyin bzhi pa'i thun dang po'i mthar khrol sgrub grub/ 'di skabs bsnyen rgyun pas zhi khro'i spyi dril kho na thun bzung*/ de nas sman btag btsag spol sogs byas la/ phyi sgrub tshugs shing bsnyen rgyun pas zhi khro'i spyi dril gnyis dang*/

phyi sgrub 'gugs sngags gsum sbrel gyi thun bzung*/ nyin lnga par phyi sgrub kyi 'gugs/ dbab/ bskyil dbab rnams sbyar/ pad+ma rgyal thebs sogs kyis dbang gi me mchod blug /nyin drug pa'i thun dang po'i rjes/ bsnyen rgyun pas zhi khro spyi dril dang*/ dngos grub gsol sngags sbrel ba thun gnyis/ sman gyi dngos grub blangs shing sman dbang bskur/ bsnyen rgyun pas zhi khro'i spyi dril gnyis kho na sngags rgyun bzung zhing*/ rin chen rgyal thebs sogs kyis rgyas pa'i me mchod blug /gtor bzlog bya zhing*/ bsnyen rgyun pas zhi khro'i spyi dril dang*/ drag po'i sham bu sbyar ba thun bzung*/ nyin bdun par gtor bzlog /nyin brgyad par bzlog pa'i zor 'phen/ drag po'i phrin las kyi ngar 'dogs su karma rgyal thebs sogs kyis drag po'i me mchod bya/ tshe sgrub rjes bsnyen rgyun bas zhi khro'i spyi dril dang*/ dngos grub sngags sbrel ba'i thun bzung*/ nyin dgu par dngos grub len cing*/ mtha' rgyas su rin chen rgyal thebs sogs kyi rgyas pa'i me mchod blugs/ rjes chog /tho grol/ mar me'i smon lam sogs mtha' rgyas su bya/ nyin re bzhin rgyal tho gso rgyu dang*/ rdo rje mtshams pas yang steng nas bsang dang*/ gser skyems kyis dngos grub bskul ba/ bka' bsgo dang rta bro'i skabs rdo rje 'tshams pas thun brab rgyu sogs bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang don gnyer can gyi 'dod ngo ma chog par sngags btsun mkha' khyab rdo rjer 'bod pas bgyis pa dge/ //PAGE PAGE 10 FILENAME E-45.doc
